name: Kabe ni Hamatte Ugokenai! 2
original_name: 壁にはまってうごけない! 2
source:
An elf magician who gets caught in a warp trap in a certain underground labyrinth.
Before he knew it, he had warped out into the wall and was unable to move.
Rather than helping the adventurers and monsters passing by, they attacked the elves...

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ121243.html]DLsite[/url]]
